question: What is the name of Bhim Singh's book launched on August 11, 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**75 Great Revolutionaries of India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On August 11, 2024, **Rajya Sabha MP Bhim Singh launched his book titled ****'75 Great Revolutionaries of India'**.
 
• **The launch event was attended by Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman Harivansh Narayan Singh, who praised the work for highlighting lesser-known freedom fighters.**
 
• **This book aims to inspire a developed India by recognizing historical sacrifices. **
 
• **75 Great Revolutionaries of India"** is that the book was released as part of the celebrations for **"Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav"**, commemorating 75 years of India's independence.
 
• It emphasizes the contributions of unsung heroes who played crucial roles in India's freedom struggle
